import rcb_dtb, mujoco

# Quaternion/pose helpers. Quaternions at the API boundary are xyzw.
def qxyzw_to_R(q):
    x,y,z,w=np.asarray(q,float); return np.array([[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w)], [2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w)], [2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]])
def R_to_wxyz(R):
    q=np.zeros(4); mujoco.mju_mat2Quat(q,np.asarray(R,float).ravel()); return q
def rotvec(R):
    c=np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)*.5,-1,1); a=np.arccos(c)
    if a<1e-8:return np.zeros(3)
    if abs(np.sin(a))<1e-7:
        # stable near pi
        eigval,eigvec=np.linalg.eigh((R+np.eye(3))*0.5); axis=eigvec[:,np.argmax(eigval)]
        return a*axis
    return a/(2*np.sin(a))*np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
def R_slerp(R0,R1,t):
    return R_to_wxyz(R0 @ exp_so3(rotvec(R0.T@R1)*t))
def exp_so3(v):
    a=np.linalg.norm(v)
    if a<1e-12:return np.eye(3)
    x,y,z=v/a; K=np.array([[0,-z,y],[z,0,-x],[-y,x,0]])
    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(a)*K+(1-np.cos(a))*(K@K)
def interp_pose(p0,R0,p1,R1,t):
    # linearly interpolate position, exponential interpolation orientation
    return p0+(p1-p0)*t, R0@exp_so3(rotvec(R0.T@R1)*t)

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.d=s.data; self.b=self.m.body('palmworld').id
        self.id=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.arm_qadr=s._jq[:7]
    def ik(self,p_t,R_t,qseed=None, maxit=80):
        # Kinematic solve on a separate data object.
        id=self.id
        id.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos; id.qvel[:]=self.d.qvel
        if self.m.na: id.act[:]=self.d.act
        id.ctrl[:]=self.d.ctrl
        if qseed is not None: id.qpos[self.arm_qadr]=qseed
        q0=id.qpos[self.arm_qadr].copy()
        for _ in range(maxit):
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,id)
            p=id.xpos[self.b].copy(); R=id.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
            e=np.r_[p_t-p,rotvec(R_t@R.T)]
            if np.linalg.norm(e[:3])<2e-4 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:])<2e-3: break
            jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,id,jp,jr,self.b)
            J=np.vstack((jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]))
            # damped least squares
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.diag([.002]*3+[.01]*3),e)
            n=np.linalg.norm(dq)
            if n>.18: dq*=.18/n
            qcur=id.qpos[self.arm_qadr]
            id.qpos[self.arm_qadr]=np.clip(qcur+dq,self.s.lower[:7]+1e-4,self.s.upper[:7]-1e-4)
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,id)
        p=id.xpos[self.b].copy(); R=id.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
        ep=np.linalg.norm(p_t-p); er=np.linalg.norm(rotvec(R_t@R.T))
        return id.qpos[self.arm_qadr].copy(), ep, er

def open_hand(s): return np.zeros(22)
def close_hand(s, amount=1.):
    h=np.zeros(22)
    # thumb, index/middle/ring/pinky flex into power grasp
    h[0]=0.8*amount; h[1]=0.05*amount; h[2]=0.75*amount; h[3]=0.0; h[4]=0.85*amount
    for start in [5,9,13]:
        h[start]=0.85*amount; h[start+1]=0; h[start+2]=1.1*amount; h[start+3]=0.75*amount
    h[17]=0.10*amount; h[18]=0.75*amount; h[19]=0; h[20]=1.0*amount; h[21]=0.75*amount
    return h

def build_linear_ik(s,c,p0,R0,p1,R1,n,qseed):
 qs=[]; errs=[]; prev=qseed.copy()
 for j in range(1,n+1):
  p,R=interp_pose(p0,R0,p1,R1,j/n)
  q,e1,e2=c.ik(p,R,qseed=prev); qs.append(q);errs.append((e1,e2));prev=q
 return np.array(qs),np.array(errs)

 s=rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json');c=Controller(s);s.record_start()
 st=s.state();p0=st['palm_pos'].copy();R0=s.data.xmat[c.b].reshape(3,3).copy();q0=st['q'][:7].copy()
 # Tilt the open fingers down as they reach over the handle, so they arrive at its underside.
 ang=np.deg2rad(30);X=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,np.cos(ang),-np.sin(ang)],[0,np.sin(ang),np.cos(ang)]])
 Rf=X@R0
 c.id.qpos[:]=s.data.qpos;c.id.qpos[7:29]=0;mujoco.mj_forward(s.model,c.id)
 ends=[s.model.body('palmleft_'+f+'_DP').id for f in ['index','middle','ring','pinky']]

 center=np.array([.16,.05,.548]);pf=center-Rf@avglocal;pstart=pf+np.array([0,.17,0]);ph=pstart+np.array([0,0,.12]);pr=p0+np.array([0,0,.16])
 qf,e1,e2=c.ik(pf,Rf,qseed=q0);print('target',pf,'IK',e1,e2,qf)
 path1,e=build_linear_ik(s,c,p0,R0,pr,R0,35,q0);print('raise',np.max(e,0))
 path2,e=build_linear_ik(s,c,pr,R0,ph,Rf,80,path1[-1]);print('transit',np.max(e,0),'last diff',path2[-1]-qf)
 path3,e=build_linear_ik(s,c,ph,Rf,pstart,Rf,55,path2[-1]);print('lower outside',np.max(e,0),'last diff',path3[-1]-qf)
 path4,e=build_linear_ik(s,c,pstart,Rf,pf,Rf,80,path3[-1]);print('insert',np.max(e,0),'last diff',path4[-1]-qf)
 for q in path1:s.step(np.r_[q,np.zeros(22)])
 for q in path2:s.step(np.r_[q,np.zeros(22)])
 for j,q in enumerate(path3):
  s.step(np.r_[q,np.zeros(22)])
  if (j+1)%10==0: print('lower',j+1,'palm',s.state()['palm_pos'],'obj',s.state()['object_pos'],'idx',s.data.xpos[s.model.body('palmleft_index_DP').id])
 for j,q in enumerate(path4):

 print('contacts',[(s.model.geom(s.data.contact[j].geom1).name,s.model.geom(s.data.contact[j].geom2).name,round(s.data.contact[j].dist,4),np.round(s.data.contact[j].frame[:3],2)) for j in range(s.data.ncon) if 'object_' in s.model.geom(s.data.contact[j].geom1).name or 'object_' in s.model.geom(s.data.contact[j].geom2).name])
 lift,e=build_linear_ik(s,c,s.state()['palm_pos'],Rf,s.state()['palm_pos']+np.array([0,0,.10]),Rf,60,path4[-1]);print('lift err',np.max(e,0))
